title: Invoice intake for a regional distributor.
summary: Illustrative example of a work entry. Set draft to false, or delete this file, once real entries exist.

hero_stat.label: Days to post an invoice
hero_stat.note: Measured over six weeks of live volume against a three-month baseline.

spec.problem: About 4,000 supplier invoices a month arrived as PDFs by email. Clerks keyed them into the ERP; 24% needed a correction.
spec.changed: Invoices are read, matched to purchase orders and vendor records, and posted automatically. Exceptions go to a clerk with the mismatch highlighted.
spec.systems: Microsoft 365 mail, the client's ERP (name withheld), Claude for extraction and matching.
spec.measured: Cost per invoice, days to post, exception rate, field accuracy, review minutes per exception, run cost.
spec.result: **Cost per invoice $11.20 to $4.10; days to post 9.8 to 2.6.** Exception rate missed its target (11% against 10%). Measured by the client's finance team.
